text:
mike: Quick notewe need a lightweight seller onramp for SIs who want to list marketplace bundles. Planning sync 2pm PT. Can folks join?

anya: I can make 2pm. Goal: define required artifacts (CFN/Helm quickstart, signed image tarball, support SLA blurb).

jess: Also need a clear cert checklist for trainers vs sellers. Sellers shouldn't have to pass full trainer cert, but need a deployment sanity check + packaging validation.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2044 for temporary build creds for partner CI (expires in 7 days).

mike: Proposal: three artifact tiers for listing: quickstart (cloud), offline bundle (tar + SHAs), and optional trainer-kit add-on. Sellers must include at least quickstart + legal-approved data processing blurb.

anya: Checklist idea for sellers: 1) quickstart deploy succeeds in <30m, 2) smoke test passes (curl generate + GPU check), 3) images pinned to SHA, 4) license & logos approved.

jess: For certification: sellers get a "Marketplace Ready" badge after passing checklist. Separate "Trainer Certified" badge for those who run partner cohorts. Different intake forms.

mike: Legal: anything else you need for the listing copy? We want minimal friction but accurate SLA wording.

legal: legal: Need explicit data processing statement and allowed demo dataset guidance. Also require a support contact and an escalation window (72h for standard).

anya: Noted. We'll add a short FAQ about recorded demos vs live checks (recorded allowed for deploy but live telemetry required for rollback/observability tests).

jess: Ops: kit shipping limited to NA/EU this quarter. We'll offer a remote lab sandbox for others. Make sure we document sandbox token request flow.

mike: I'll draft the seller checklist doc and a one-page marketplace brief. Target: draft by EOD tomorrow. Who can review?

anya: I'll review the tech checklist.

jess: I'll review packaging and trainer-gap notes.

mike: Cool. Also create a tiny smoke test snippet for the docs:

mike: ```bash
# smoke test for marketplace quickstart
export TOKEN=$SANDBOX_TOKEN
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"test"}' | jq .
ssh kit 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv'
```

anya: Put that in the quickstart appendix. I'll add manifest pinning instructions for air-gap flows.

legal: legal: Once draft copy is ready tag us. Also attach approved logo assets.

mike: Thanks. I'll post draft in this thread and create calendar invite for 2pm PT. Short pilot with 3 sellers first.

jess: +1. Keeping pilot small will help support.

mike: Thanks team. I'll share links in the invite. :thumbsup:
